title: Fusion WebView Macro Recipe Specification & Template

doctrine.priority: API-First (Direct API Claim via in-page fetch / browser_api_call)
doctrine.execution_engine: In-Memory V8 JIT Single-Shot (0ms delay, Zero-Reload between wallets)

formatting.provider_log: Clean '[PROVIDER] Injeksi: eso-X' (no sliced address, no chain tag)
formatting.status_log: Clean '✓ [STATUS] SUKSES: Terkonfirmasi (+X TKN) (Durasi: Ys)' (no duplicate tx hash)
formatting.sanitization: Zero technical jargon: strip '(Zero-Reload)', '(0ms roundtrip)', '(Bypass UI)'
formatting.email_context: Display email info in banner ONLY if recipe uses {{EMAIL}}, {{OTP}}, wait_otp, or explicit CLI flag

events.script: const address = wallet.address; const targetUrl = window.location.href; const res = await fetch('/api/v1/claim', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ address, ref: 'eso' }) }); const data = await res.json(); return { success: res.ok, tx: data.txHash || data.txDigest, reward: { amount: 0.1, symbol: 'TOKEN' }, ...data };
const res = await fetch('/api/send_otp', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ email: '{{EMAIL}}' }) }); return await res.json();

events.desc: Wait OTP from Cloud-Mail / email.txt pool

events.script: const res = await fetch('/api/verify_claim', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ email: '{{EMAIL}}', code: '{{OTP}}', address: wallet.address }) }); const data = await res.json(); return { success: res.ok, reward: { amount: 100, symbol: 'PTS' }, ...data };
